li.label: sent a parcel home
li.description: I packed a parcel for my family and sent it off with a trader. I keep picturing them opening it.

li.label: a letter read at supper
li.description: Someone read their letter from home out at supper. All that small news from people I've never met, and I enjoyed every word.

li.label: taught a young guest a trade
li.description: I spent a day showing a young visitor how we make things here. They went home knowing how, and that was my doing.
